Not just another conference! but a meaningful connection among industry leaders, where memorable moments are created. It was a pleasure to join the NEXT Pharma Summit as a speaker, bringing together pharma leaders to explore the future of AI and commercial innovation. One thing became clear: we’re at an inflection point. 👉 AI is rapidly moving from experimentation to real commercial impact 👉 The future of pharma won’t be defined by technology alone. It will be shaped by how we integrate human understanding with innovation In the middle of all the AI conversations, it was a powerful reminder that legacy, experience, and human factor matter—more than ever. I was very pleased to be part of an Oxford-style debate as the winning side, with the importance of the human factor. Most valuable of all: being surrounded by inspiring colleagues, because momentum starts with the inspiration we find in one another. Thank you to the NEXT Pharma team Dario Safaric Petra Safaric for an outstanding event. #NextPharma #Innovation #AI #Healthcare #Leadership #Pharma

More than a debate win, this was a powerful reminder: of the importance of legacy, and most importantly, the true value of the human factor. What I enjoyed most? Sharing that stage with two inspiring leaders, Elijah Robinson and our moderator Geoff Covey. Diverse viewpoints, mutual respect, and a dialogue that challenged and elevated all of us. Because ultimately, the real value isn’t in winning the debate— it’s in the exchange, shared learning, and the perspectives that broaden our horizons. Grateful for this experience and the people who made it meaningful! My sincere thanks to Dario Safaric and his outstanding team for organizing such a fantastic experience. #Leadership #HumanCentered #AI #BrandStrategy #Perspective #Legacy #Innovation #Mindset #Pharma #NextPharma #NEXT26 #OxfordDebate

Ideas Without Borders Come to Life 🚀 Global Commercialization Hackathon 2026 Mission accomplished—and what an incredible journey it has been. Last week, we brought to life hybrid AI Hackathon within the Global Commercialization community—and seeing it unfold was truly inspiring. With 130+ participants across 22 cities and 16 countries, colleagues came together in Berlin, Basel, and virtually worldwide to turn bold ideas into real solutions. What made it special was the energy in the room (and across screens)—a shared ambition to innovate, collaborate, push boundaries and create 30+ working prototypes built in just one day. For me, this was more than just an event—it was a powerful demonstration of what we can achieve when we connect diverse perspectives and create space to experiment, build, and move fast together. Proud to have co-organized this milestone event together with: Aude de Grivel , Mario Kossmann , Jesus del Valle , Alen Meštrov , Alan How , Megan Druce , Richard Hutchings , Stephen Privitera, Mike Yates, Robert Westphal, Same Mehmari , Joan Tan , Robin von Kanitz , Franz Kranke , Stephan Brebeck , Stefan Riesch —and our sponsor Rob Vermeulen ✨ Thank you for making this vision into reality This would not have been possible without an amazing collective effort And of course, to every Idea Owners 🦁, Vibe Coders ⚡, and Mentor 🎓—thank you for your passion, creativity, and courage to step forward and make an impact. 💫 This is just the beginning #Innovation #Hackathon #AI #Collaboration #IdeasWithoutBorders #TeamBayer

activity.text: “Create a superhero picture of me based on my email box, working documents, personality analysis and feedback from surveys and a selfie photo” - this was the prompt we used in a meeting to train AI skills and as icebreaker. This is the result that came out for me. I found it very flattering. I felt genuinely represented by the statements, but there was one thing that shocked me: the face does not look like me at all! I tried several times to prompt to change it to my features, but the AI insisted to keep make me look this very beautiful in generic way- seems it found it more fitting to the superhero stereotype. So it just make me reflect: ✨AI is very good at depicting skills and recognizing strengths in a very generalized way ✨it is strong at making us look good, but also like everybody ✨it fails to show the uniqueness and the individuality of our personality How to make sure that in the world where AI is used everywhere we are not getting standardized and replaceable as persons? On the opposite how to use our individuality as an advantage? Three ideas: ✨ Cultivating an own distinct style in language, ways of working and even your appearance will be a differentiating factor for success in business ✨ Showing weakness and vulnerability makes us human and is differentiating from AI also in professional context ✨ Acting different, taking risk and beeing truly creative will be even more powerful if everybody else acts in the same logic and stereotypes promoted by AI In the end, AI can enable us to make more impact to where we are unique than where we are conform. I find that encouraging.

I am delighted to share a new chapter in my professional journey as Global Pharma Learning & Capabilities Director at ESTEVE . I feel genuinely excited and grateful for the opportunity to continue doing what I enjoy most: building capabilities, enabling transformation, developing people, and helping teams create a meaningful impact for customers and patients. Looking back, I feel incredibly fortunate for all the opportunities and experiences I have had throughout my career, and for all the people I have met along the way: leaders, colleagues, teams, affiliates, and partners across many countries who trusted me, challenged me, supported me, taught me, and helped me grow. I am equally grateful for all those I have had the opportunity to support, coach, develop, and learn from throughout my career. One of the greatest rewards of working in Learning is realising that growth is never one-way. Every interaction, every project, and every person leaves a mark and contributes to who we become. After many years working in global roles, one belief has only become stronger: the best strategies are built when we stay close to people and local realities. Listening, collaborating, understanding what is truly needed, and finding pragmatic ways to move forward together have always been central to the way I work. I strongly believe in continuous improvement, collaboration, pragmatism, accountability, and ownership, creating an environment where people can thrive and perform at their best. I am delighted to bring this mindset and experience to ESTEVE at such an exciting moment in its transformation and growth in highly specialised medicines and rare diseases. Most importantly, I am excited about continuing this journey alongside talented colleagues who share a common purpose and commitment: Improving Lives Together. Grateful for the journey so far, for all the people who have been part of it, and excited to continue learning, growing and contributing in this new chapter. #ESTEVE #LearningAndDevelopment #CapabilityBuilding #Leadership #Transformation #RareDiseases #ImprovingLivesTogether

Thrilled to share that I’ve started the Art History and Art Business course at Sotheby's Institute of Art in London this week! There is something so energizing about going back to school and feeding the soul with new knowledge especially in an area which has been a long term passion of mine. Those who know me have heard about my dream to run a museum one day. I decided to follow this dream and explore the Culture and Arts world while continuing to build on my executive leadership background. I am excited to dive deeper into the intersection of art historical context and the commercial dynamics of the art world. Looking forward to an inspiring journey of learning, connecting with fellow art enthusiasts, and exploring new perspectives. #SothebysInstitute #ArtBusiness #ArtHistory #CulturalLeadership #LifelongLearning
